It looks like we need you confirm a few more details about {!var_Unconfirmed_Allocs} of {!var_Alloc_Count} allocations related to this request.


Select a row to review and confirm shipping and logistic details for that allocation, or go back to the allocation table and click "Configure Shipping Details" on these columns.

Please review and ensure the information below is accurate. If everything looks correct, select Continue to proceed to the final submission page. If you need to make changes now, or at a later time, select Cancel and all of your progress will be saved.

fields.name: Verify_Screen
fields.fieldText:
Submit Request to Amplify


Below are the details for the allocation you are about to submit. Please Note: Once you submit, all allocations and logistics are considered final and you will not be able to update any details for your allocation thereafter. We cannot change or hold your order, and any changes made after submission will not impact or update your submitted order. If you have any questions, please reach out to Amplify Support.

fields.name: multi_year_text
fields.fieldText: This order is a multiyear order. You are not required to take all of your order quantities unless it is the final year of the order. We have provided a current year suggested quantity in your first allocation column below.﻿
